{{Top|canon=Glow worm}}
{{Quote|Ah&hellip; Very good worms. Now you always have light, even in darkest cavern. Good light. Light good for great Wookiee. Also, good food, if hungry.|Unidentified alien creature, to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and companions|<ref name="Star Wars Missions 15: Voyage to the Underworld">''[[Star Wars Missions 15: Voyage to the Underworld]]''</ref>}}
'''Glowworms''',<ref name="Star Wars Missions 15: Voyage to the Underworld" /> or '''glow-worms''',<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> were luminescent [[Worm/Legends|worms]] from the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]<ref name="Star Wars Missions 15: Voyage to the Underworld" />and the subterranean caverns of [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].<ref name="YDR" /> A single glowworm was approximately the size of a loaf of [[Jawa bread]]. [[Giant walking fish]] liked to eat glowworms.<ref name="Star Wars Missions 15: Voyage to the Underworld" />

[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] heroes&mdash;[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], or [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]&mdash;were given glowworms by winged [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] while searching for [[Phelon]]. Chewbacca's companion was forced to eat a glowworm to appease their new acquaintances, and thought it would taste good with [[Tatooine Thunder]] sauce.<ref name="Star Wars Missions 15: Voyage to the Underworld" />
